title: Linking to an entry with a different description keeps it and shows the Part created … was kept toast
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-E1, a Part Library entry with no part behind it; before the run note its description in Parts → Part Library ("{library description}"). Pick Category before typing Cost (known pre-existing: Cost first sends calculate-sell-price with an empty category → 400 "Invalid UUID" / "Failed to calculate sell price.").
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory click New Inventory Part (button_new_inventory_part).
  2. Type Description "QA S7 typed description" (input_part_description) and Part Number "QAPL-E1" exactly (input_part_number); pick a Category and type Cost 10.00.
  3. Click Save (button_save_inventory_part) and watch the toast without clicking it.
  4. Search QAPL-E1 on the Inventory list.
  5. Go to Parts → Part Library and search QAPL-E1.
  6. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. The dialog opens with Description first, then Part Number; there is no Part Library selector.
  2. Both fields take the typed text.
  3. The dialog closes; the success toast (toast_part_linked_to_library) reads exactly: Part created. Linked to QAPL-E1 in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept. It fades on its own.
  4. The new row shows "{library description}", not "QA S7 typed description".
  5. Exactly one entry QAPL-E1, still showing "{library description}".
  6. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
